verdict.rationale: Rippling's marketing pages say users can build custom workflows that trigger automatically on events, such as bonus reminders or a Slack alert fired from a Zendesk ticket. They also describe background automation like account provisioning and deprovisioning, attribute sync to third-party apps, and Rippling AI approving dependent coverage on its own. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the workflow builder (triggers, scheduling, conditions), independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably unattended, and evidence of AI-defined (agentic) automation setup beyond marketing claims.
